main_body: A central vertical pole (x~17-22) with spiral stair steps fanning out left and right as wedge-shaped treads, drawn like a side cut of a spiral staircase
top_band: none: the central pole has a 1-row light cap (row 13, L=176) with no wider plate; the treads are wedge profiles with light faces and dark undersides, not a coherent horizontal top surface
evidence: Column x=16 reads as a 1-row light cap (row 13) over a 36-row flat shaft of one tone (L=99), which is the red flat-band column cap of the guide. The steps are fan wedges seen as a side cut, with alternating light/dark bands and no continuous top surface over a front face. This is a spiral staircase seen as a side cut, which fails as a side elevation.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 9 distinct colours against 66 and 185 for the references. Its median of 9 per tile is below the 11 and 18 of the references. About 56% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, against 7-9% for the references, so the outlines lean toward a near-black sticker look. The material is a grey ramp of about 4 steps (L 24, 74, 99, 150, 176) with little grain or per-stone shading, and it is much thinner than the stone house reference.
